tasks.subject: Task 1: Contact schema migration + backfill
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add typed email, externalId, source, inactive, inactiveAt columns to Contact. Backfill email from existing email-attribute rows. Add partial-unique indexes via raw SQL.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["packages/database/schema.prisma", "packages/database/migration/<TIMESTAMP>_add_contact_mirror_columns/migration.sql"], "verifyCommand": "docker compose -f docker-compose.local.yml exec postgres psql -U postgres -d formbricks -c '\\d \"Contact\"'", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Contact has email, externalId, source, inactive, inactiveAt", "All existing contacts get source=manual", "Email backfilled from email-attribute rows", "Partial unique on (environmentId, email) WHERE email IS NOT NULL", "Partial unique on (environmentId, externalId) WHERE externalId IS NOT NULL", "Idempotent on re-run"]}
```
